Synthetic Turf Installation – Project Description

The proposed scope of work includes the removal of existing organic material as needed, followed by preparation of a stable, well-compacted base suitable for synthetic turf installation. Base preparation will include excavation to proper depth, installation of a compacted aggregate base, fine grading, and leveling to ensure proper drainage and long-term performance.

Once the base is prepared, synthetic turf will be installed according to industry standards. This includes rolling out the turf, trimming and fitting to the designated area, securing seams with approved seam tape and adhesive, anchoring the perimeter, and applying infill material as required for stability and appearance. All materials used will be designed for outdoor use, UV-resistant, and compliant with HOA and local code requirements.

The completed installation will provide a clean, low-maintenance, and visually consistent landscape surface while maintaining proper drainage and not altering existing water flow patterns.WRONG PERMIT TYPE
